thread:
maria_cs: Customer acme-inc (acct_8742) says trial credits auto-expired during our scheduled billing DB maintenance. They tried to apply promo 'ACME50' at ~10:12 UTC but got a 401 auth_error. Promo didnt apply and balance shows 0. Asking for manual reinstatement and policy clarification.

alex.k: Can you paste the request/response if available and the customer email? Also confirm whether they used a server token or a JS/browser flow.

maria_cs: Email: dana@acme.com. Txn id from client: txn_20260315_4912. Customer supplied this snippet: 
```
POST /v1/credits/apply
Authorization: Bearer <token-redacted>
{"promo": "ACME50"}
# response 401
{"error": "auth_error", "message": "token expired"}
```
They say attempt was at 2026-03-15T10:12:24Z.

sam_ops: We had a scheduled maintenance window 10:00-10:30 UTC for billing DB failover. We rotated short-lived auth tokens at 10:05 to flush sessions. If the client retried with a stale token it would return 401 and the promo apply would never reach the promo engine. This lines up.

jordan_eng: @sam_ops can you confirm whether the promo apply is single-step (auth then apply) or if we queue and retry? If it's single-step, customer-side retries with the same token will always fail until they fetch a new token. We should also check if the promo service logged the incoming request for txn_20260315_4912.

billing-bot: PromoService: detected 1 failed apply (txn_20260315_4912) during maintenance window; no rollback entry created.

support_lead: Given this is a trial/demo for a paying prospect, +1 to a manual, prorated credit grant and 30-day trial extension. Document as policy exception. Maria, please proceed and record grant id.

maria_cs: Granting 500 trial credits / 30d extension now. Manual grant id: mg_88421. Updated balance: 500 credits. Confirmed with customer; they said "that should save our demo, thanks" :relieved:.

alex.k: Thanks. Please add a short note in the case: root cause = auth token rotation during maintenance causing promo apply to fail client-side; customer retried without refreshing token. Resolution = manual credit grant + trial extension.

jordan_eng: Action items: (1) Add server-side defensive retry when auth TTL mismatch detected so we return a clearer error (suggestion: 409 with guidance to re-auth) or attempt a token-refresh flow for server-to-server tokens. (2) Postmortem entry in incidents channel.

sam_ops: I'll add a follow-up to the maintenance runbook to broadcast token rotations and include a header in the token response to encourage clients to do an immediate refresh.

maria_cs: Customer acknowledged and will proceed with demo. Closing ticket after follow-up notes are posted.

alex.k: Please link the postmortem and the case ID here once done. Thanks everyone.
